definitions.select:
SELECT ?root ?verification ?result ?definition_revision ?applicable ?results_support ?results_facts ?knowledge_complete WHERE {
?root <urn:mara:query:input:results> ?results_row .
?results_row <urn:mara:query:column:results:verification> ?verification .
?results_row <urn:mara:query:column:results:status> ?status .
?results_row <urn:mara:query:column:results:result> ?result .
?results_row <urn:mara:query:column:results:definition_revision> ?definition_revision .
?results_row <urn:mara:query:column:results:applicable> ?applicable .
FILTER(sameTerm(?status,"accepted"))
OPTIONAL { ?results_row <urn:mara:query:column:results:results_support> ?results_support } OPTIONAL { ?results_row <urn:mara:query:column:results:results_facts> ?results_facts }
?results_row <urn:mara:query:column:results:knowledge_complete> ?knowledge_complete .
}
